en: Colorized panoramic view of a small European town set in a valley with surrounding hills and fields. In the foreground there is a large cultivated field, then rows of houses with red and dark roofs, several larger multi‑story buildings and factory‑like structures, and church spires in the distance. At the top left there is red printed text that reads "Olbernhau i. S. Total." The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century lithographic postcard showing the town in its entirety.
